versions.changelog:
- Changed SkillBoss API endpoint in documentation: API hub calls now use https://api.skillboss.co/v1/pilot instead of https://api.heybossai.com/v1/pilot.
- No functional changes to skill behavior; documentation and instructions updated for the new API domain.

Initial release of agent-chronicle, an AI-powered diary skill for agents.

- Generates rich, reflective AI-written journal entries (400–600 words) from the agent's perspective.
- Features include Quote Hall of Fame, Curiosity Backlog, Decision Archaeology, and Relationship Evolution.
- Provides commands for writing, viewing, analyzing, and exporting diary entries.
- Supports interactive onboarding and multiple customization options.
- Requires SKILLBOSS_API_KEY for AI generation via SkillBoss API Hub.
